units.title: The actual matrix-Chebyshev cosine identity
units.reader_note: The exact matrix conclusion comes first. Conditions, formula proof and exact Lean are folded beside it; the full private Gaussian application is available at step6.
units.statement: The first-kind Chebyshev polynomial of the normalized hard-family precision is its same-rotation cosine diagonal.
assumptions: Let \(d\ge2\) be natural, \(\kappa\ge2\) real, and \(O\in O(d)\) a full real orthogonal matrix. Both determinant signs are allowed. This is a fixed-input algebraic statement, with no algorithm or Haar-independence premise.

Use the literal midpoint grid \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), precision eigenvalues \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\), and \(A=O\Lambda O^\top\). Lean's zero-based coordinate is \(i_{\rm val}+\tfrac12\).

The auxiliary identity holds for every natural \(n\), including zero. The source proof specializes to \(n=2q+1\). \(T_n\) is the usual first-kind polynomial; its matrix evaluation maps real coefficients to scalar identity matrices.

The private application allows every real \(\tau\), with source instance \(\tau_{d,q}\). Put \(\mu=N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\), \(Rz=Oz\), \(S_A(x)=(-1)^n x^\top T_n((2A-(\kappa+1)I_d)/(\kappa-1))x-2\tau\|x\|^2\), and \(E_A=\{S_A>0\}\). It proves Borelness and a literal \(\mu\circ R^{-1}\) event-mass equality; identifying that law with \(\pi_A\) remains separate.

Scalar \((\kappa-1)^{-1}\) in the normalized matrix and matrix \(\Lambda^{-1}\) in the Gaussian covariance are different operations. Nonzero scalar domain, orthogonal identities, continuity and measurability are produced internally. No moment, probability, rotation-law, query-budget or cost certificate is an input.

notation.text: The same literal midpoint precision family and full hidden orthogonal basis.
Actual normalized matrix, cosine diagonal, intrinsic signed statistic and strict event.

steps.title: Use the existing orthogonal conjugation automorphism
steps.text: The same full orthogonal matrix defines the canonical star-algebra automorphism Φ(M)=OMOᵀ. It preserves the identity, addition, scalar multiplication and polynomial evaluation. The source condition κ≥2 supplies κ−1≠0 inside the proof.
steps.detail: The implementation reuses Unitary.conjStarAlgAut. It creates no duplicate generic conjugation lemma, and does not restrict O to determinant1.
steps.lean:
let Φ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ ≃ₐ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) O).toAlgEquiv
  have hΦ (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
      Φ M = (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * M *
        (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose := by
    change (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * M *
      star (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) = _
    simp only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  have hnz : κ - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith

steps.title: Normalize the literal precision before evaluating the polynomial
steps.text: Calculate each diagonal entry directly from the displayed eigenvalue formula. Lift this scalar calculation through the same conjugation. This establishes the actual normalized matrix, rather than assuming its diagonalization.
steps.detail: The complete scalar/diagonal normalization and its lift are shown. No affine identity or reciprocal-domain certificate is supplied by the caller.
steps.lean:
have hD :
      (κ - 1)⁻¹ • ((2 : ℝ) • Λ - (κ + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)) = D := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sub_apply, Λ, D,
        Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_eq, mul_one]
      field_simp [hnz]
      ring
    · simp [Λ, D, hij]
  have hA : A = Φ Λ := (hΦ Λ).symm
  have hB : B = Φ D := by
    dsimp only [B]
    rw [hA]
    calc
      (κ - 1)⁻¹ • ((2 : ℝ) • Φ Λ - (κ + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)) =
          Φ ((κ - 1)⁻¹ • ((2 : ℝ) • Λ - (κ + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))) := by
        simp only [map_smul, map_sub, map_one]
      _ = Φ D := congrArg Φ hD

steps.title: Evaluate through the canonical algebra maps
steps.text: Polynomial evaluation commutes first with Φ and then with the diagonal algebra homomorphism. Evaluation in a tuple is componentwise. Apply the existing scalar first-kind identity T_n(cos θ)=cos(nθ), with the explicit natural-to-integer index conversion, then return to O-conjugation.
steps.detail: Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, Matrix.diagonalAlgHom, Polynomial.aeval_pi_apply and Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_real_cos are genuinely reused. Real matrix polynomial evaluation is not entrywise evaluation.
steps.lean:
have hdiag : Polynomial.aeval D (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i)) := by
    change Polynomial.aeval ((Matrix.diagonalAlgHom (n := Fin d) (α := ℝ) ℝ) (fun i => Real.cos (θ i)))
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)) = _
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, Polynomial.aeval_pi_apply]
    change Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Polynomial.aeval (Real.cos (θ i))
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ))) = _
    apply congrArg (Matrix.diagonal : (Fin d → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
    funext i
    change (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)).eval (Real.cos (θ i)) = _
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_real_cos (θ i) (n : ℤ)
  change Polynomial.aeval B (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)) = _
  rw [hB, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, hdiag, hΦ]

steps.title: Produce the strict event's Borel property
steps.text: For the fixed matrix T_n(B), its quadratic form is the Euclidean inner product of x with a continuous linear image of x. The norm-square term is continuous too, so S_A is continuous and its strict positive set is Borel. The actual rotation R is a continuous linear map. This branch does not need the new cosine identity.
steps.detail: A typed pointwise equality connects the existing inner-product identity to the exact coordinate formula. The resulting event measurability and rotation measurability are consumed by Measure.map_apply.
steps.lean:
have hR : Measurable R :=
    (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)).continuous.measurable
  have hSc : Continuous S := by
    have hq : Continuous (fun x : E =>
        (WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) := by
      have hi : Continuous (fun x : E =>
          inner ℝ x (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) T x)) :=
        continuous_id.inner (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) T).continuous
      have heq : (fun x : E =>
          inner ℝ x (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) T x)) =
          (fun x : E => (WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) := by
        funext x
        exact Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM T x x
      rw [← heq]
      exact hi
    exact (continuous_const.mul hq).sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_norm.pow 2))
  have hEvent : MeasurableSet {x : E | 0 < S x} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const hSc.measurable

steps.title: Transform the actual statistic on every vector
steps.text: Apply the compiled producer to the actual matrix in the private test. Orthogonality supplies OᵀOz=z. The canonical unitary continuous-linear-map theorem preserves the Euclidean norm. Bilinear transpose identities then reduce the rotated quadratic form to the coordinate cosine sum, including z=0.
steps.detail: The private proof materially calls the new public declaration. It uses the full orthogonal group and makes no division by the squared norm, so no fallback weights or nonzero-vector premise is needed.
steps.lean:
have hO : (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose *
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' (n := Fin d) (R := ℝ)).mp O.property
  have hundo (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose *ᵥ
        ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hO, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hnorm (z : E) : ‖R z‖ = ‖z‖ := by
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_map_of_mem_unitary
      (Unitary.map_mem (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d)) O.property) z
  have hquad (z : E) :
      (WithLp.ofLp (R z)) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp (R z)) =
        ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp z i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hT]
    change ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z) ⬝ᵥ
      (((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * D *
        (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose) *ᵥ
          ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z)) = _
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hundo]
    rw [← Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec, hundo]
    simp only [D, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hstat (z : E) : S (R z) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp z i) ^ 2) -
        2 * τ * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [hquad, hnorm]

steps.title: Evaluate the actual pushforward on this event
steps.text: Use the derived Borel and rotation properties to evaluate the actual pushforward measure on E_A. Substitute the pointwise statistic identity in its preimage. The strict inequality excludes zero on both sides; the result is an exact ENNReal mass equality with no probability estimate or toReal conversion.
steps.detail: The complete private Test module is folded here. The actual measure is multivariateGaussian0Λ inverse. Equality with multivariateGaussian0A inverse, the target pass probability, concentration, algorithms and both main lower bounds remain separate.
steps.lean:
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumDetector
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Multivariate
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Matrix
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

open Matrix InnerProductSpace MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
Actual private source detector consumer. Both conjuncts are proved internally:
the intrinsic polynomial event is Borel, and its mass under the actual
rotated pushforward diagonal Gaussian equals the strict diagonal event mass.
This does not identify that pushforward with multivariateGaussian0 A inverse
or prove a high-probability/algorithm/query lower bound.
-/
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumDetector

private theorem actual_rotated_gaussian_detector_event {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin d) ℝ) (n : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i))
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
    multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) Λ⁻¹
  let R : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    fun z => WithLp.toLp 2 ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z)
  let A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * Λ *
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose
  let B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    (κ - 1)⁻¹ • ((2 : ℝ) • A - (κ + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))
  let S : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ n *
      ((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ ((Polynomial.aeval B (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ))) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) -
      2 * τ * ‖x‖ ^ 2
  MeasurableSet {x | 0 < S x} ∧
    (μ.map R) {x | 0 < S x} =
      μ {z | 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ n *
        (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp z i) ^ 2) -
        2 * τ * ‖z‖ ^ 2} := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i))
  let μ : Measure E := multivariateGaussian (0 : E) Λ⁻¹
  let R : E → E := fun z =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z)
  let A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * Λ *
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose
  let B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    (κ - 1)⁻¹ • ((2 : ℝ) • A - (κ + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))
  let T : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Polynomial.aeval B (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ))
  let D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i))
  let S : E → ℝ := fun x =>
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * ((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) -
      2 * τ * ‖x‖ ^ 2
  have hT : T = (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * D *
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumDetector.actual_chebyshev_matrix_cosine hd hκ O n
  have hR : Measurable R :=
    (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)).continuous.measurable
  have hSc : Continuous S := by
    have hq : Continuous (fun x : E =>
        (WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) := by
      have hi : Continuous (fun x : E =>
          inner ℝ x (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) T x)) :=
        continuous_id.inner (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) T).continuous
      have heq : (fun x : E =>
          inner ℝ x (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d) T x)) =
          (fun x : E => (WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) := by
        funext x
        exact Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM T x x
      rw [← heq]
      exact hi
    exact (continuous_const.mul hq).sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_norm.pow 2))
  have hEvent : MeasurableSet {x : E | 0 < S x} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const hSc.measurable
  have hO : (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose *
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' (n := Fin d) (R := ℝ)).mp O.property
  have hundo (v : Fin d → ℝ) :
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose *ᵥ
        ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hO, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hnorm (z : E) : ‖R z‖ = ‖z‖ := by
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_map_of_mem_unitary
      (Unitary.map_mem (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin d)) O.property) z
  have hquad (z : E) :
      (WithLp.ofLp (R z)) ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp (R z)) =
        ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp z i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hT]
    change ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z) ⬝ᵥ
      (((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) * D *
        (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose) *ᵥ
          ((O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp z)) = _
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hundo]
    rw [← Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec, hundo]
    simp only [D, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hstat (z : E) : S (R z) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp z i) ^ 2) -
        2 * τ * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [hquad, hnorm]
  change MeasurableSet {x : E | 0 < S x} ∧
    (μ.map R) {x : E | 0 < S x} = _
  refine ⟨hEvent, ?_⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply hR hEvent]
  apply congrArg μ
  ext z
  change (0 < S (R z)) ↔ _
  rw [hstat]
  rfl

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumDetector

units.lean_statement: Literal hard-family matrix, full real O, d>=2,kappa>=2, every natural n; no diagonalization, moment or measurability certificate is an input.
units.lean_proof: Canonical unitary conjugation and diagonal algebra maps commute with actual polynomial evaluation after explicit scalar normalization. The complete private Gaussian event application proves and consumes continuity/measurability, norm preservation and all-vector quadratic transport.
units.boundary: This packet proves only the literal hard-family matrix-Chebyshev/cosine identity and a PRIVATE actual rotated-pushforward Gaussian strict-event equality with Borelness. Natural n and real tau are explicit auxiliary families; source specialization is n=2q+1,tau=tau_dq. The scalar reciprocal and covariance matrix inverse, full O(d) and strict zero boundary remain exact. The actual mu.mapR law is not yet identified with pi_A, and no high-probability conclusion, concentration-valid absolute C, Krylov/deferred-rotation/adaptive/Haar law, algorithm/oracle/TV/precision/query-cap/cost adapter or either complete main lower bound is supplied. Source topology v1 TC-B1 HOLD and the independently accepted minimal v2 remain preserved. Local compilation, independent postproof source/native/reader verification, normal sourceV, serialized latest-main integration, public source/Lean/index/graph/desktop/mobile delivery, purification and Exposition Seal are distinct stages.
